title: RepoMesh Plan Receipt v1
description: 200 response of POST /api/v1/agent-actions/leader/assignments/{taskId}/plan. The idempotency contract: the first accepted submission and every identical resubmission for the same leader task return this same document — same workerTaskIds, same planRevision — with 200. A conflicting second plan for the same leader task is 409 phase_conflict, never a silent replacement.

planRevision.description: 1 for the original plan. Reserved to grow only through the formal rework path; a leader cannot bump it by resubmitting.

workerTaskIds.description: The worker tasks the accepted plan created, in workerTasks order. Stable across idempotent resubmission.
